summary: Grays Harbor County, WA: 10x12 ft cabin dated 1930; abandoned by 1940; only shingles and boards remain. Reached by a gated road on land Willhite says was owned by Green Diamond in 2018.

facts.design: 10x12 ft cabin per register (Willhite: 10x12 or 14x14 ft depending on source)
facts.status_note: Abandoned by 1940; only shingles and boards remain, per Willhite

access.note: Route crosses Green Diamond land, which Willhite reports was open to hiking, biking and horses in 2018; the access road is gated (signed 6850) and parking is at the gate. Check current access.

visit.trail_note: Park at the gate and hike up the road signed 6850; 3/4 mile with about 350 feet of gain (Willhite)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates the cabin to 1930; Willhite says the site was used sometime in the 1930s and does not give a build year. Both are kept in the story.

notes_for_editor: Identity: Willhite's page is titled Kelly Hill; the match rests on the 880 ft elevation, the Grays Harbor County location and the Brady/Matlock route, consistent with the register and firelookout.com ('5 miles WNW of Matlock'). Ownership conflicts: the register credits Washington Division of Forestry/DNR, while Willhite reports Green Diamond ownership in 2018; he also cites a 1940 memo that places the site under a Simpson heading and notes a typo in it. Build year: register says 1930; Willhite says sometime in the 1930s. Cabin size: 10x12 in register and firelookout.com, 14x14 in another account Willhite mentions. Access rests on Willhite's undated page, which describes 2018 ownership; confirm the gate and landowner before publishing.
